name.en-US: In Praise of the New Knighthood

description.la: Liber ad milites Templi de laude novae militiae, quem Bernardus Hugoni de Payns scripsit.
description.en-US: Bernard’s book for Hugh of Payns and the Knights Templar: the contrast between worldly knighthood and the new knighthood of Christ, and a meditation on the holy places, with Mabillon’s admonitio. Latin only, from the Maurist text in Migne, a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: O livro de Bernardo para Hugo de Payns e os cavaleiros templários: o contraste entre a milícia do mundo e a nova milícia de Cristo, e uma meditação sobre os lugares santos.

la.editor: Jean Mabillon, in J.-P. Migne (Patrologia Latina 182)

sources.edition: S. Bernardi Claraevallensis abbatis opera omnia, ed. J. Mabillon, in Migne, Patrologia Latina 182 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), work 6158, from machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text with Mabillon’s admonitio, chapter headings and summaries. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and so are the paragraph numbers; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed.
sources.tierEvidence: Bernard died in 1153; Migne’s printing is public domain everywhere.
